# Hindi (हिंदी) translation review

<!-- GENERATED by scripts/i18n-review.mjs (npm run i18n-review). Do not edit by hand. -->

Every user-visible string, English next to Hindi, for a native speaker to check. To ask for a change, comment on the line in the pull request, or edit `src/ui/i18n/hi.js` (UI) or the preset's `translations.hi` (exams) and run `npm run i18n-review`.

Placeholders like `{w}` are filled in by the app (numbers, file names, exam names). Numbers stay in Western digits; "ExamSnap" is never translated.
